description: Full details of one alohacamp.com property: address and coordinates, rating, description (Polish), location description, house rules, check-in/out times, cancellation policy, each unit type (capacity, rooms, beds, area), amenities, surroundings with distances, things to do, fees, meals, photos, recent reviews and nearby properties. With date_from/date_to it also prices the stay for the party: per unit whether it fits, how many are free, the minimum stay, the exact total and nightly price (PLN, incl. AlohaCamp's service fee), plus a booking link. Get the slug from alohacamp_search. Fetched live from alohacamp.com (typically 1–2 s via direct fetch; a few seconds more right after AlohaCamp deploys, or when it falls back to an unblocker). Result: { source, fetchedAt, property: { id, slug, name, url, address, lat, lng, rating, review_count, indicative_price_per_night, currency, check_in, check_in_until, check_out, free_cancellation, free_cancellation_hours, description, location_description, house_rules, units, amenities, surroundings, things_to_do, getting_there, fees, meals_available, meals_included, host, photos, recent_reviews, nearby }, stay?: { date_from, date_to, nights, adults, children, infants, pets, booking_url, units: [{ name, type, fits_party, available_units, min_nights, max_guests, total_price, price_per_night, price_from_per_night, extra_fees }], note? } }.

date_from.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD — pass with date_to to price the stay.

infants.description: Infants (babies) — AlohaCamp does not count them toward a unit's capacity. Default 0.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

pets.description: Pets travelling along; > 0 also limits results to pet-friendly places. Default 0.

property.description: The property's slug from alohacamp_search (e.g. 'masuria-lakehouse-518'), its alohacamp.com URL, or its numeric id.

name: alohacamp_property
title: Get one AlohaCamp property
